compiled_state.title: As a sprint operator in ci-pr mode, story PRs are opened against the session branch instead of main so the session->main PR is the sole path to main
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Refactor Sprint Phase F to open story/* PRs with base=session_branch instead of base=main, and use the shared SESSION_BRANCH resolution helper (resolve-session-branch.sh) for branch resolution.

**Why**: The current Phase F auto-merges story PRs directly to main, orphaning the session draft PR and triggering redundant whole-PR re-reviews (~3 per 5-story sprint). Changing the PR base to session_branch makes the session→main PR the single merge gate, enabling provenance verification and narrow integration review.

**Scope**:
- IN: Update per-worktree-review-commit.md and create-story-branch.sh (or their callers) to open story/* PRs with base=session_branch; add DSO-Story-Merge trailer to commits merged into session branch via merge-story-branch.sh; consume resolve-session-branch.sh for SESSION_BRANCH resolution; update sprint SKILL.md Phase F references
- OUT: Updating debug-everything Phase F/G (S4); GitHub Ruleset setup (S3); provenance verifier (S5); local mode is byte-identical to pre-epic behavior

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, Sprint Phase F creates story/* PRs with base=session_branch (not main); verified by a representative sprint producing sub-branch PRs with the expected base via `gh pr view --json base`
  ← Satisfies: "sub-branch PRs base on session-branch" (SC4)
- When this story is complete, the session→main PR is the sole path to main; no story/* PR auto-merges to main
  ← Satisfies: SC4 workflow enforcement
- When this story is complete, merge-story-branch.sh adds DSO-Story-Merge trailer (format documented inline) to merge commits on the session branch; trailer schema is documented in a contract file consumable by the S5 provenance verifier
  ← Satisfies: SC5 skill convergence; enables SC1 provenance
- When this story is complete, SESSION_BRANCH is resolved via resolve-session-branch.sh (3-step fallback); fail-fast on resolution failure
  ← Satisfies: Operational Constraint (SESSION_BRANCH resolution failure)
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] The DSO-Story-Merge trailer format introduced by merge-story-branch.sh is an implicit contract consumed by the S5 provenance verifier and S8's cafb reproducer. Document the trailer schema (field names, casing, line position) in the same commit as a contract file (e.g., docs/contracts/dso-story-merge-trailer.md) and add a contract test asserting the verifier parses what the merge script writes.
- [Reliability] SESSION_BRANCH resolution uses resolve-session-branch.sh with 3-step fallback; fail-fast on failure. Do not silently default to main.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
